about.bio: I'm Giorgi, a Front-End Developer based in Georgia. I specialize in building responsive, user-focused interfaces using React, TypeScript, and Next.js, with a strong eye for clean, maintainable code. My focus is on turning ideas into polished, interactive experiences from real-time platform features to creative, visually engaging projects like 3D scenes and interactive games.

prj_06.description: Guess My Number is a number guessing game where the player tries to identify a randomly generated secret number between 1 and 20. Each wrong guess costs a point and reveals a hint — the score system tracks your best result across rounds.

prj_07.description: Pig Game is a two-player dice game built with React and TypeScript. Players take turns rolling a die and accumulating points — but rolling a 1 resets the turn. The first to reach 100 wins.
